messages.content: The driver canceled after making me wait 15 minutes, and I was still charged a fee.
I'm sorry you were charged after the driver cancelled. Check your trip history and fare breakdown. If the fee looks incorrect, report it through support for review.
The driver took a much longer route which increased the fare.
I'm sorry the route increased your fare. Compare the route and final fare with your trip details. If the route or charge seems incorrect, submit a fare review request.
The driver arrived, but the car’s AC wasn’t working on a very hot day.

I'm sorry you had to travel in an uncomfortable car. You can report the vehicle issue through the app. If you were charged for a service that wasn't provided as expected, ask support whether a fare review is available.
The driver refused to go to my drop location even though it was in the app.

I'm sorry the driver refused your listed destination. If you're still on the trip and feel unsafe, prioritize your safety and contact local emergency services if needed. Otherwise, report the incident through the app and request a review of any charges.
The fare shown at the end was much higher than the estimate.

I'm sorry the final fare was higher than expected. Check the fare breakdown for route changes, waiting time, or additional fees. If the amount still looks wrong, request a fare review through support.
The driver accepted the ride but never moved toward my pickup location.

I'm sorry the driver hasn't moved toward your pickup point. Check the driver's live location and contact them through the app if available. If the ride appears stuck, use the app's support or cancellation options and check whether a fee applies.
The driver charged extra for luggage even though it wasn’t mentioned anywhere.
I'm sorry about the unexpected luggage charge. Check the fare breakdown and the app's luggage-fee policy. If the fee wasn't disclosed or doesn't match the policy, report it to support for review.
The driver picked someone else and marked my ride as completed.

I'm sorry—this is a serious ride-status issue. Check your trip history and report that the driver picked up someone else and marked your ride complete. Contact support promptly to dispute any charge. Don't share sensitive payment details in chat.
The driver was playing loud music even after I requested to lower it.

I'm sorry the driver continued playing loud music after you asked them to lower it. You can report the behavior through the app. If you feel unsafe during the trip, prioritize your safety and seek appropriate assistance.
The driver left before I reached the pickup point even though I was on time.

I'm sorry the driver left while you were on time. Check the trip timeline and contact support if the pickup or cancellation was recorded incorrectly. Review any cancellation fee before requesting a charge review.
